text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…………
……Is that girl not here?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Biwa Hayahide-san!
Congratulations on winning the URA Award in the Senior division!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I am honored by your praise.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Still, the lineup for this year's URA Awards is truly incredible, isn't it?
With Hayahide-san, Hishi Amazon-san, and all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon in particular—
her achieving the Triple Tiara was a magnificent feat.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it is a shame your younger sister isn't here with us.
Ever since I watched the Satsuki Sho, I was certain she would be..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah. S-Sorry!
Um, err.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I'm praying your leg injury heals quickly.
Because I want to see you run again,
Biwa Hayahide-san!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

After New Year's passed, training resumed once again.
And after practice ended on this day――

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's not even 6 o'clock yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I can still run.
choice_data_list: Taking care of your health is part of training, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hm.
It's good to work hard, but in winter, the cold air outside can easily have all sorts of effects on your muscles.

Taking that into account, we've recently been spending
a generous amount of time on warm-ups and cool-downs.
choice_data_list: I won't let you get hurt.
I won't let you get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Such a worrywart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fine. You don't get stronger by resting.
I know that all too well myself."

And after finishing cleaning up,
on the way escorting Narita Brian back to the dorm...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis. Heading home now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You've been training all this time, Brian?
...You're working hard.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "My Trainer was nagging me, so I'm finishing early today too."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You two seem to make
a truly wonderful pair.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I never thought Brian would listen
to someone else so obediently.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll listen, of course. To get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Their skills as a Trainer aren't half bad.
Besides, running through the Twinkle Series with them this past year taught me something.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure I still don't understand
what true strength is at its core."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That is why I want to know. And why I desire
the strength to clash with those fierce competitors.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...You really are endlessly
sincere when it comes to running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...That was the kind of rival I wanted to race against.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ? Sis?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, right.
Sorry."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Brian.
Would you care to have a mock race with me sometime?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the day we can face off as friendly rivals.
Normal race distances are out of the question for me, but
if it were a shorter distance...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I refuse. As I am now, I am merely on the path.
Besides, Big Sis is one of the formidable rivals I must defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If we're to battle, it must be on a GⅠ stage.
Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you.
Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: I hope I get to race against Biwa Hayahide this year.
It'd be nice to get to race Biwa Hayahide this year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Just as you know,
my big sister is strong.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose either, though.
Not until I leave everyone in the dust in a GⅠ!
